reviewEvidence.provenance: Completed actual author inspections: 231 complete families/487 senses including twenty principals/29 senses, 207 actual labels, 118 complete old articles, 32 components and six related kanji cards. inspectionStageAdvance.originalInspectionStatus: Prepared, not inspected; record completed actual reads separately.
inspectionStageAdvance.completedInspection: All eight selected complete-family chunks and eighteen selected existing-body chunks were actually read, as were all 202 original labels, 32 component records, principal records and both public renderings. Ten further existing bodies and all eleven supplemental complete families were read. Repeated identities are deduplicated.
sourceMappingDecisions: Nineteen new articles plus narrow additive extension of existing N3 備える. Preserve its metadata and earlier teaching; explicitly recognize rare 具える and teach possession with を備えている (sense 3). Do not select since-birth sense 4.
Normalize rare source 卒直 to usual article 率直, explicitly teaching both with the source reading. Primary written metadata is 率/直, not 卒. A qualified 卒 alias backlink is navigation, not a primary pair.
続々 and 蕎麦 are new identities, not reuse of shivering ぞくぞく or spatial 側. 剃る has primary source そる; its alternate する is not irregular do.
そのうえ selects additive and separately explained literal senses. そのほか selects rest/others, addition and list-extension senses; raw otherwise does not authorize an or-else conditional.

蕎麦 selects plant and current そば noodle senses, with source anchor sense 2. Explain wheat-noodle compounds without asserting every そば dish is all buckwheat; do not transfer noodle senses to older readings.
Raw blank glosses for N2:956 and N2:961 remain blank. Pinned entries establish the selected teaching, without recovered compiler-intent claims.
crossReferencePlan: Six primary reciprocal N2 pairs: 総/総理大臣, 臣/総理大臣, 測/測定, 測/測量, 量/測量, 麦/蕎麦. 麦 uses a separately labelled whole-word そば row, never invented 麦=ば.
卒's rare alias backlink is explicitly qualified and not put in Common words. Other useful old-word edits are links only; primary kana spellings do not acquire alias-only kanji metadata.
sourceAccessLimits: Original capture-only remainder remains uninspected: 168 of 389 families and 94 of 202 original bodies, except any explicitly promoted supplemental identities/bodies counted in this receipt.
Twenty-one positive endpoint captures are not twenty-one distinct lexical families: 卒直/率直 and 具える/備える repeat bodies. その他 returns そのた, not a direct そのほか heading.

Five completed endpoints have no extracted SGKDJ body: そのころ, そのため, そのほか, その頃 and その為. 其の頃 separately returned HTTP404 before the successful narrowed alias run; no partial output from that run is positive evidence.
Seven speculative comparison strings were absent as exact spellings/readings in pinned JMdict and removed from the actual 306-form request. This is not a grammaticality judgment.
Actual-read assertions are the author's, not independent findings or runtime quiz certification. No exhaustive dictionary, corpus, historical-origin or native-speaker verification is claimed.

quizGuardRationale: Author hypotheses, not reviewer findings or actual quiz draws. Direct symmetric/nontransitive pairs assess actual complete labels and ordinary senses. Exact titles deduplicate; shared topics and homophony alone do not establish pairs. Assess excessive guards as well as omissions.
総理大臣 directly overlaps 首相, not every minister or president. 送料 assesses broad actual fee/cost/price labels without equating shipping charge and purchase price in every context.
続々 assesses successive/continuous labels, not shivering ぞくぞく. 速達 considers broader delivery 配達 without equating it with express trains or all urgency words.

測定/測量 and actual measuring/observation/dimension labels warrant direct precautions; questionnaire 調査 is not land surveying. 速力 overlaps actual speed/rate labels including 時速 without being inherently high speed.

素質 considers aptitude, ability, nature/character/constitution and ordinary secondary character meanings of 人物/カラー. 性's actual selected sex/gender senses and 腕's arm title do not automatically make new pairs. Potential is not guaranteed achievement.
祖先 protects synonymous 先祖; descendants and grandparents are not synonymous by family topic. そそっかしい assesses actual careless/hasty/rash labels, not physical speed alone.
率直 considers 正直/素直 and まっすぐ's ordinary figurative straightforward/honest use; a geometric title alone does not exhaust the latter's teaching.
そのうえ considers additive labels and separately taught literal 上. そのころ considers actual at-that-time/about-time labels without inventing a short/long period split.

そのため considers causal/consequential labels and すると's resulting-event use; cause and purpose remain context-sensitive. そのほか considers rest/other/except/addition/list-extension senses; otherwise does not authorize or-else.

剃る assesses actual shave/shave-off/cut/clip senses, not every personal-care tool. それなのに assesses actual adversative labels including otherwise polysemous connectors without making every use interchangeable.
No new guards for 属する, 蕎麦 or reused 備える. Belonging, shivering and spatial-side homophones are distinct identities. New-new 測定/測量 and そのうえ/そのほか are each declared once.
sourceAccessLimits: Twenty rows map nineteen new articles plus narrow rare-alias/possession extension of N3 備える. Baseline metadata, easier levels and original teaching are preserved except the updated source citation.
N2:956 and N2:961 have blank raw glosses, preserved verbatim. 其の頃 is not in principal 2547920 and is not taught; a failed request proves neither an alias nor ungrammaticality.
其の他/其の外/其他 are search-only forms, not recommended rare spellings. Written-form preference for そのた is a tendency, not an exclusive reading rule.
蕎麦's source sense 2 is separate from additional plant 1 and Chinese-style noodle 3; noodle senses are restricted to そば. Whole-word reading is not 麦=ば.
Six primary reciprocal pairs: 総/総理大臣, 臣/総理大臣, 測/測定, 測/測量, 量/測量, 麦/蕎麦. 卒/卒直 is separately qualified alias navigation, not a primary pair.

Only 118 old full bodies were inspected. Unselected original captures remain capture-only. Eleven supplemental complete families add ten distinct identities/eighteen senses, not eleven new identities.

Twenty-one positive original endpoints are not twenty-one distinct lexical families. Five extractions failed; その他 returns そのた. A separate HTTP404 is retained as a limit. The additional 率 character entry is outside those counts.

Six old articles change links only. File-only reviewers cannot independently execute Git/hash/equivalence checks; author checks, validators and CLEAN judgments do not establish exhaustive linguistic correctness or runtime quiz uniqueness.

adjudications.decision: Add 属する/入る. Complete 1465590:3 at はいる includes belonging in a category/coming under a heading, matching 1405710:1. Retain the valid joining-versus-affiliation comparison; it does not exhaust 入る's ordinary senses.
Add 続々/ばたばた. Complete 1098660:3 and the complete old article explicitly teach successive falling, matching 1596730:1. Existing edges through 次々 or どんどん are not transitive protection.

Add both そして and そうして to each of そのうえ and そのほか. Complete 1006730:1/1612860:1 and both old articles explicitly include addition; titles emphasizing sequence do not erase it. New additive anchors are 1006880:1 and 1006900:2. No unrestricted construction substitution is claimed.

Add 測量/調査 for actual surveying/measurement versus investigation/survey titles, 1404590:1 and 1429120:1. Retain the Japanese measuring/investigating distinction; the guard does not claim that every 調査 measures land.

Original metadata apart from this exact list, N3, ID, reading, title and all pre-existing teaching remain unchanged. Preservation audit permits only this explicitly recorded addition.

Replace the unnecessary voicing warning with repetition of the already attested on reading ゾク: ぞく + ぞく. The actual component record for 続, not the reviewer's imprecise principal-reading location, supplies the KANJIDIC2 anchor.

adjudications.decision: Add the attested 人類の祖先 phrase with kana/translation and remove family-only wording in the component explanation. Original Daijisen 祖先 sense 3 supports the broader scope. Do not add a claimed household-versus-scientific register rule or arbitrary species examples without evidence.

Use 十年前のことです。そのころ、私は大阪に住んでいました。 with kana and translation, making the antecedent explicit. The original repeated reference was not demonstrated ungrammatical; this is a modest naturalness/clarity improvement, not a certified native-speaker correction.

adjudications.status: overlap clarified; unsupported frequency/register prescription declined
adjudications.decision: Explain that しょくする has an overlapping belonging sense and other uses, while this article teaches ぞくする. Original Daijisen lists overlapping sense 1. The reviewer's rare/literary/mainly entrust claim is not established by the captured body or the triangle marker and is not inserted. Existing reading-specific usage link supplies the source.

adjudications.status: pronunciation note qualified without invented regional distribution
adjudications.decision: Attribute Daijisen's altered-pronunciation note なまって to する, retaining the verified godan distinction from irregular do. This does not establish a specific region, current frequency or unrestricted colloquial register, so those proposed labels are not inserted.

After reading complete 昔 1382370 (both senses) and its entire old article, add a precaution for in-those-days versus the-old-days answer wording. This does not equate all uses: そのころ can identify a future time; 昔's ordinary old-days use cannot. Not retrospectively a shared initial actionable finding.

No established requirement was found for exhaustive JMdict footer lists in kanji cards. そのため's selected spelling paragraph does not claim to list every variant. No harmful over-exclusion was demonstrated for 素質/人物 or カラー. 蕎's separate kun-reading record does not invalidate the existing whole-word 蕎麦 explanation or justify assigning ば to 麦. These remain nonblocking, not hidden unresolved consequential claims.

correctionEvidence.modelDiversity: Complete reports, including Optional and Limits, compared. Only 測量/調査 is a shared initial actionable observation. GPT uniquely supplies eight further direct guard pairs; Claude uniquely supplies five localized explanation/coverage/naturalness observations (the example is optional polish) plus an optional 昔 precaution. Some Claude remedies exceed their evidence and are narrowed, not adopted literally. Equal frozen snapshot/scope/rubric/access, but unequal actual reading depth: GPT read the complete family union and 108 extra old bodies; Claude read compact principals/components/labels and assigned content but not the full comparison union or additional old bodies. Useful complementary catches on this sample, not a controlled bias experiment or model ranking.
correctionEvidence.limits: Author adjudication, not confirmation. Eight new articles and only the exact quiz list of reused 備える change.
